aboutME.title: About Me...
aboutME.description:
Software Developer with a B.Sc. in Computer Science. Hands-on experience developing software systems through academic and personal projects, with a solid understanding of development workflows, teamwork, and writing clean, maintainable code.

Primary focus – Backend Development: Experience building backend services and REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot, working with microservices-based architectures, and integrating with both relational and non-relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB). Additional backend experience with Python and Flask (including SQLAlchemy) and development in C#.

Distributed systems, infrastructure, and tooling: Experience working with Docker, version control using Git, and CI/CD processes (including Jenkins). Hands-on exposure to Kafka and Redis, usage of Elasticsearch, and implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms using Keycloak and JWT. Basic experience with Dapr as part of distributed system components.
